title: Coronary Artery Disease and Coronary Microvascular Disease in Cardiomyopathies Registry
official: Coronary Artery Disease and Coronary Microvascular Disease in Cardiomyopathies Registry
summary: Long-term prognostic value of macrovascular and microvascular coronary artery stenoses in each type of cardiomyopathy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ischemic
* Dilated
* Hypertrophic
* Restrictive cardiomyopathy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women
* Breastfeeding women
* Patients under legal protection
